summary: legal checked in 5 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Recommendation: retain the private launch gate. Woot API access is documented, but rights for storage, derivatives, public display, alerts, or monetization are not established; all four launch-readiness legal tasks remain open. Smallest next step: attach the consolidated read-only evidence bundle and keep outreach unsent pending owner and human-counsel authorization.

Risk disposition: blocked for public beta or full launch of the gated product; counsel_required for upstream data rights, jurisdiction-specific privacy treatment, vendor/DPA obligations, and future affiliate or advertising use. Exact decision: keep private. Evidence shows API access mechanics only; rights to store, derive, cache, publicly display, alert on, or monetize returned data are not established, and current public terms point against those uses. Accuracy/freshness, security, privacy, attribution, measurement, and owner gates also remain incomplete. Ordinary reversible fleet growth is conditional where existing consent, cookie/analytics disclosure, terms, affiliate disclosure, claims, provenance, rights, and platform-policy boundaries are preserved. Incomplete telemetry alone is not a blocker. Compliance is a technical baseline only: 37 pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown. Revenue evidence covers one day, with $4.92 aggregate commission and $0 site-attributed commission; ROI, margin, and causal lift remain unknown.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 legal tasks are closed. Partial evidence is recorded for official source documentation and terms, repository/configuration data-flow files, privacy and cookie pages, and draft terms. No task is closable because authoritative rights, operator-confirmed retention and user workflows, deployed consent and GA4 settings, log/vendor inventory, incident/request procedures, and counsel review remain incomplete. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only bundle containing the field-level rights matrix; alert identifiers and data flow; retention, deletion, correction, and access workflows; notification consent and unsubscribe behavior; GA4 configuration and retention; log fields; vendor/DPA coverage; and incident/request procedures. Keep the permission request unsent pending owner and human-counsel authorization.

Data-use review: Woot API deal and price-history data = blocked. Missing current written permission or API agreement, field-level provenance and rights, caching/display/alert terms, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark/image/price-use limits, and affiliate or advertising permission. Smallest next action: complete the field-level rights matrix and route the unsent permission package for human-counsel and owner review. User alert rules and sync results = evidence_needed. Missing data inventory, retention, deletion/correction/access workflow, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest next action: produce the repository/deployed data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics = evidence_needed. Missing deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property and data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional review. Smallest next action: capture existing consent and GA4 configuration without enabling tracking. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data = evidence_needed. Missing log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor terms or DPA review, incident handling, and data-request procedures. Smallest next action: produce a read-only operator/vendor inventory and identify counsel-required gaps.

Fleet compliance, data quality, analytics, revenue, site, and launch evidence do not support general legal clearance. Site-specific compliance failures and unknowns require remediation or evidence; analytics permission and collector errors remain data-quality issues, not automatic growth blockers. Revenue attribution remains partial and aggregate earnings must not be assigned to sites. Do not infer claims support, copyright/trademark clearance, data provenance, age suitability, regulated-use compliance, or platform-policy compliance from domain names or portfolio labels. For private or gated properties, retain an explicit keep-private decision and require completion of the launch checklist before exposure or monetization. Continue only existing containment, failure repair-or-close, scheduled measurement, and bounded read-only security evidence work; create no new production work, duplicate telemetry request, spend, requeue, monetization expansion, or external outreach.
